items.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
items.summary: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

items.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
items.summary: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

items.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
items.summary: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

items.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
items.summary: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.

items.title: Strategy Buys $82M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $188M of STRC
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm sold $284 million of MSTR stock to fund the moves, days before MSCI names companies facing index removal.

items.title: Microsoft-Backed Space and Time Launches Platform to Let AI Agents Verify Private Data
items.summary: Space and Time Enterprise uses Proof of SQL to prove calculations on private business data without exposing the records to AI agents.

items.title: StoneX sees 97% upside for Bullish as $4.2 billion Equiniti deal opens tokenization market
items.summary: StoneX initiated coverage of Bullish with a Buy rating and a $42 price target, implying roughly 97% upside from its current levels.

items.title: Coinbase and PNC Bank expand partnership with USDC payments for corporate clients
